pairs.rationale: The dependent must use reduction potentials to choose the spontaneous direction, construct half/overall reactions and explain external electron flow. These tasks require identifying the electron donor/acceptor and coupling oxidation with reduction. The proposed redox prerequisite covers this coherent narrow role concept with supplied Zn/Cu and Fe/Cu equations, without requiring the separate full oxidation-number, full stoichiometry or complete cell-theory competencies. Its only prior requirement is the Chemistry orientation anchor.

pairs.dependentTitle: Planare chromatografische Trennungen durchführen und auswerten
pairs.rationale: The complete planar-chromatography goal requires the learner to perform a locally released separation, handle samples/solvents, prepare and label the station, and document personal actions. It cannot be completed by the synthetic Rf card alone. Basic eye protection, label checks, a clear station and stopping/reporting a splash or unclear vessel are necessary before this actual handling, across the selected pigment/food/indicator/amino-acid alternatives. The safety prerequisite adds no chemical-theory block; its inherited orientation is already reachable in the retained route through the pure-substance/mixture foundation. Local method and material release remain specific supplied conditions, not proof of general safety mastery.

pairs.dependentTitle: Saure, alkalische und neutrale Lösungen unterscheiden
pairs.rationale: Both indicator cases require personal supervised transfer of released solutions to labelled vessels and handling of wet strips/paper, including the brim-filled test-tube procedure. Eye protection, vessel identification, controlled handling and immediate stopping/reporting after contact or a problem are genuine prior practical basics. This is the general laboratory-safety goal, not the full hazard-classification or chemistry-of-acids competence. Teacher release and the detailed product instructions do not replace learner application of those basics. The only inherited anchor is the Chemistry orientation, already inherited by the dependent itself.

pairs.prerequisiteTitle: Chemische Symbole und Formeln sicher nutzen
pairs.rationale: The direct symbol/formula competence fits the task: the learner must interpret H2O, CO2, NO3− and CO3²−, count atoms/electrons and preserve the skeleton while constructing Lewis/resonance representations. The new edge nevertheless also makes the entire Dalton-model goal mandatory through e7c363d4.requires. That full P requires separating observation, law and hypothesis and explaining isotope/subatomic limits of the historical model. Those are separate learning achievements; supplied element counts, valence-electron totals and fixed skeletons do not require prior mastery of that epistemological/historical goal. ACCEPT of the direct notation foundation is withheld for this candidate path until that extra gate is resolved. The existing electron-pair/orbital predecessor is recorded as a retained path, not freshly approved here.

pairs.prerequisiteTitle: Chemische Symbole und Formeln sicher nutzen
pairs.rationale: Reading element symbols, ion/molecular formulas, subscripts and whole-particle coefficients is a necessary narrow foundation for assigning local oxidation numbers and checking the Mn/Fe and ethanol/CuO atom/charge balances. This supports the direct symbols/formulas edge. Its inherited whole-Dalton requirement additionally demands law/model/hypothesis discrimination and isotope/subatomic-model critique. Neither balancing the given reactions nor distinguishing oxidation numbers from particle charge requires that whole achievement in advance. Formal electron accounting and the specified redox work are the target learning here. The proposed addition therefore stays HOLD as wired, pending resolution of the unnecessary Dalton gate.
